encoding: Existing wire.canonical: sorted-key UTF-8 JSON, integers only; P-256 ECDSA SHA256 DER signature standard padded base64

invite.trust: Scan trusted local display; signature proves integrity only. Normal CA, hostname, TLS1.3 and pin validation required. No secrets in packet.

requests.signature_proof: All body fields except signature, plus method=POST and path=exact full route. No additional fields accepted.

responses.request_sha256: SHA256 of canonical full request including device signature
responses.session: Same existing MOBILE_SESSION and signed v1 /status transport; owner_authority=NOT_BOUND; status READ only
responses.state_semantics: REVOKED means the previously approved request was revoked or its approval digest was superseded by another exact approval for the same key. A new unapproved request remains PENDING until exact approval or expiry; re-pairing never restores an older request to APPROVED or COMPLETED.

sas: decimal zero-padded six digits: integer(first 8 hex digits of request_digest) modulo 1000000
request_digest: SHA256 canonical begin signature proof (all unsigned request fields plus method/path)
readback: Never repeat begin/approve/complete/reconnect automatically. Duplicate mutations 409. After lost begin or approve ACK signed status identifies exact request. After lost complete/reconnect ACK use fresh signed challenge/reconnect to replace old session. Restart invalidates invites/pending/short sessions/challenges; durable device binding survives under same host key/origin/scope and newly OS-authenticated host. Source updates require fresh challenge tied to current source. Revoked bindings require new QR plus exact approval. Fresh challenge replaces any previous challenge for that device. Device nonce retention lasts through issued_at+30s (including permitted future skew). Reconnect rotates one existing MOBILE_SESSION per durable device; no lifetime reconnect limit.

pairing_list.pending: begin_status_data array; all current-instance phases, max128
pairing_list.access_semantics: revoked describes durable QR reconnect approval. active_sessions and pending_enrollments count unexpired, current-instance/source/scope access paths; fresh explicit legacy owner approval can authorize these while durable reconnect remains revoked. Either operator revoke entry point always revokes current sessions and consumes outstanding legacy grants, including after a prior durable revoke.

capacity: Existing Core audit and database limits remain fail-closed. Transport rotation avoids an independent reconnect lifetime counter but does not bypass Core quota; no evidence deletion or quota expansion is implemented.
